name: Hoshi
traits:
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Con, +1 Int
Speed: 30 feet
Skill Proficiency: Chakra Control, Ninshou
Hoshi Techniques: The Hoshi Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).
[BOX]
| Star Sickness / Max Ranks: 5, [Persist], [Elemental] / A creature suffering Star Sickness is suffering the radiation of overusing the meteors chakra. / A Star Sickened creature suffers a -2 penalty to all damage rolls they for each rank they have. / A Star Sickened creature makes Strength and Dexterity checks and saving throws at disadvantage. / A Star Sickened creatures with 3 or more ranks of this condition cannot regain hit points except from short or long rests. / A Star Sickened creatures with 5 ranks of this condition cannot regain hit points except by Long Rests. / If a Star Sickened creature is part of the Hoshi Clan, then ranks of this condition cannot be reduced by Non-Hoshi Clan features, Jutsu or effects if the creature afflicted. / A Star Sickened creature reduces this condition by 2 ranks at the conclusion of a Long Rest. |
[/BOX]
Hijutsu Flexibility: Hoshi Clan Hijutsu can use either Constitution or Intelligence as its casting ability score.
[BOX]
| #### Kujaku Mode / Fortitude Amp / Your body manifests 8 fluttering tail feathers made of Star Chakra; / Cosmic Plumage. You gain temporary hit points equal to twice your maximum Star Chakra. If you begin your turn without these temporary hit points, you regain them. / Meteoric Speed. You gain a +10 bonus to your speed. This increases to +20 at 11th level. / Star Power. At the beginning of each of your turns, you gain Temporary Star Chakra equal to half of your maximum Star Chakra. / Star Sickness Boon(s) / Star Sickness (1+ Rank): When you take Chakra damage, you siphon some of the attacks chakra, turning it into Temporary Star Chakra, gaining an amount equal to half the chakra damage they rolled. / Star Sickness (2+ Ranks): Hoshi clan Hijutsu you cast cannot be dispelled except by effects at least 1 rank higher than it. / Star Sickness (3+ Ranks): Increase damage you deal with Hoshi Clan Hijutsu by 1d6 force damage. This increases to 2d6 at 7th level and 3d6 at 15th level. / Star Sickness (4+ Ranks): You gain an additional Reaction each round, which can only be used to cast a Hoshi Hijutsu or use a Hoshi clan feature. / Star Sickness (5 Ranks): Hoshi Hijutsu and Kujaku abilities that inflicts ranks of Weakened or Bruised, now instead inflicts ranks of Star Sickness on hostile creatures. |
[/BOX]
